name: WF-409 — Seller Qualification Conversation & Motivation Extraction Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const conversationId=String(b.conversationId??'').trim(); const message=String(b.message??b.text??'').trim(); const channel=String(b.channel??'').trim().toLowerCase(); return [{json:{...b,leadId,conversationId,message,channel,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Seller Qualification Conversation').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const text=input.message.toLowerCase(); const lead=ctx.lead??{}; const seller=ctx.seller??{}; const property=ctx.property??{}; const suppressed=Boolean(ctx.suppressed||lead.suppressed||seller.suppressed); const dnc=Boolean(ctx.dnc||lead.dnc||seller.dnc); const closed=Boolean(ctx.closed||lead.closed); const scoreTerms=(terms)=>terms.reduce((n,t)=>n+(text.includes(t)?1:0),0); const motivationSignals={financial:scoreTerms(['need cash','money','financial','behind','debt','bills','payment']),relocation:scoreTerms(['moving','relocate','relocation','leaving town']),distress:scoreTerms(['repair','damaged','problem','vacant','foreclosure','taxes','delinquent']),timing:scoreTerms(['asap','soon','this month','next month','weeks','days']),inheritance:scoreTerms(['inherit','inherited','estate','probate']),landlord:scoreTerms(['tenant','rental','landlord','property management']),life_event:scoreTerms(['divorce','job','retire','retirement','death'])}; const motivations=Object.entries(motivationSignals).filter(([,v])=>v>0).map(([k])=>k); const urgency=motivationSignals.timing>=2?'high':motivationSignals.timing===1?'medium':'low'; const propertyCondition=scoreTerms(['needs work','needs repairs','fixer','damaged','renovation'])>=2?'distressed':scoreTerms(['good condition','updated','remodeled','renovated'])>0?'good':'unknown'; const priceMention=text.match(/\$\s?([0-9,]+(?:\.\d+)?)/); const mentionedPrice=priceMention?Number(priceMention[1].replace(/,/g,'')):null; const ownerOccupied=scoreTerms(['i live there','my home','my house'])>0; const sellerGoals=[]; if(scoreTerms(['cash','money','paid'])>0)sellerGoals.push('cash'); if(scoreTerms(['quick','fast','asap','soon'])>0)sellerGoals.push('speed'); if(scoreTerms(['close','closing'])>0)sellerGoals.push('simple_closing'); if(scoreTerms(['no repairs','as is','as-is'])>0)sellerGoals.push('as_is_sale'); const motivationScore=Math.round(Math.min(100,30+motivations.length*10+(urgency==='high'?20:urgency==='medium'?10:0)+(sellerGoals.length*5))); const qualification=motivationScore>=75?'high_motivation':motivationScore>=50?'moderate_motivation':'low_or_unclear_motivation'; const nextAction=suppressed||dnc||closed?'do_not_contact':qualification==='high_motivation'?'priority_human_conversation':qualification==='moderate_motivation'?'continue_qualification':'nurture_and_collect_information'; const idempotencyKey='wf409:'+input.leadId+':'+(input.conversationId||input.receivedAt); return [{json:{...input,context:ctx,qualificationExtraction:{status:suppressed||dnc?'blocked':closed?'closed':'active',qualification,motivationScore,motivations,urgency,sellerGoals,propertyCondition,mentionedPrice,ownerOccupied,signals:motivationSignals,nextAction,confidence:Math.round(Math.min(95,50+motivations.length*8+(input.conversationId?10:0)))},guardrails:{suppressed,dnc,closed},idempotencyKey}}}];

meta.notes: Motivation extraction is deterministic scaffold logic pending production AI/NLP contract, conversation schema, consent policy, and verified InsulaCRM API mapping.
